description: This walk follows a section of the Cleveland Way from Scarborough to Ravenscar. The route runs for just under 11 miles along the waymarked path with some moderate climbs along the way. From the cliff top trails there are some splendid sea views to enjoy. The walk starts at the Royal Albert Park in Scarborough and heads north along North Sands beach to Scalby Mills and Hayburn Wyke where there's a lovely beach, a secluded cove, woodland trails and a pretty waterfall. You then head along a series of cliffs before descending into Ravenscar where the route finishes.You can continue your walking on theLyke Wake Walk.
